Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she saw a big, dark cloud in the sky. She knew that meant it was going to rain soon.
Lily ran inside her house and told her mommy, "Mommy, it's going to rain soon. I don't want to get wet." Her mommy said, "Don't worry, Lily. We can stay inside and play games until the rain stops."
Lily was happy to hear that. She loved playing games with her mommy. They played games like hide and seek and tag. After a while, the rain started to pour down. Lily's mommy said, "We have to go inside now, Lily. It's getting dark and we don't want to be outside."
Lily was sad to leave her friends, but she knew her mommy was right. She said goodbye to her mommy and went inside. She was happy to be inside where it was warm and dry.

Suddenly, Lily saw a big, scary dog. She was scared and didn't want to go near it. Her mommy told her not to worry and that the dog was friendly. Lily felt better and they continued to play. 
After a while, Lily's mommy said it was time to go home. Lily didn't want to leave the park, but her mommy said they had to go. Lily felt sad because she didn't want to leave the park. But then, her mommy said they could come back another day. Lily felt happy again and they went home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she saw a big, bright sunflower in her garden. It was so pretty and yellow! 
Lily's mom came outside and said, "Lily, be careful not to get too close to the sunflower. It might be scary." 
Lily didn't listen and ran over to the sunflower. She touched it and felt its soft petals. Suddenly, she heard a loud noise. It was a bird! The bird was flying towards her and she got scared. 
Lily ran back to her mom and said, "Mommy, I saw a bird! It was so loud!" Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, it was very loud. But don't worry, it's a nice bird. Let's go inside and have some cookies." And they went inside to enjoy a yummy treat together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore the world. One day, she went into her neighbor's yard and saw a big, red apple hanging from a tree. She wanted to eat it, but it was too high for her to reach.
Lily thought of an idea. She went inside and got a ladder. She climbed up and reached for the apple, but it was too heavy. Suddenly, a strong wind blew and the apple fell on the ground. Lily picked it up and took a bite. It was delicious! She was so happy that she had saved it from being eaten.
From that day on, Lily knew that even though she couldn't eat apples, she could still have fun and learn something new. And she always remembered to ask for help when she needed it.
